subject.title: feat(feishu): pass through form_value, input_value, option(s) from card actions

question: What agent-visible payload format should Feishu card-action callbacks use when `form_value`, `input_value`, `name`, `option`, or `options` are present?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the permanent message shape affects downstream agents and plugin authors, and linked PRs propose different structured-JSON versus command-text formats.

options.title: Structured JSON Payload
options.body: Pass `action.value` and Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving simple button command/text extraction when no sibling fields are present.

options.title: Command-Text Append
options.body: Append form/select data into the existing command text path, reducing surface change but making spaces, objects, and empty selections harder to parse reliably.

options.title: Pause Until Rebased Proof
options.body: Keep this PR open until the branch is rebased onto the current parser and includes live Feishu proof for the chosen payload shape.

recommendation.title: Structured JSON Payload
recommendation.body: Pass `action.value` and Feishu form/input/select fields as JSON text while preserving simple button command/text extraction when no sibling fields are present.

likelyOwner.reason: The package metadata identifies this handle as the Feishu plugin contact, and the decision is about the Feishu plugin payload contract.
